name: Battle

components.pose: She plants her feet and drives her living-wood staff into the ground with both hands, chin lifted, a determined, fierce gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.headwear: a crown of antlers woven with vines and small flowers
components.jewelry: a {{METAL}} leaf gorget with {{GEM}} dewdrops, vine-wrapped bracers
components.legs_feet: leather greaves wrapped in living moss
components.effects: Huge roots and thorned vines burst up from the earth around her and tear through the barricades, petals and leaves whirling, {{MAGIC}} light running through the vines.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
